content.user_title: Measure Paid Ad Changes With Controls
content.value_statement: Paid teams often judge campaign changes from noisy before and after snapshots. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to compare fixed windows against controls and choose Promote, Keep-testing, Rollback, or Unproven.
actual_capabilities: Defines readback windows after the campaign exits learning phase.
Compares candidate performance against a control instead of raw before and after changes.
Normalizes attribution windows, currency, conversion lag, and data source labels.
Delegates ROAS and CPA arithmetic to the ROI calculator workflow.
Produces a decision table and handoff summary for paid measurement records.
limitations: Does not fetch ad platform data unless an optional connector is available.
Does not replace clean conversion tracking or export quality.
Does not calculate ROI ratios itself; it delegates that work.
Cannot prove causality when no valid control or holdout exists.

use_cases.title: Read Back Budget Changes
use_cases.description: Check whether a budget increase held ROAS against an unchanged campaign over a fixed window.

use_cases.title: Compare Platform Performance
use_cases.description: Normalize attribution windows and currency before comparing Meta, Google, or other paid channels.

use_cases.title: Flag Measurement Blockers
use_cases.description: Identify broken tracking, double counting, or missing controls before a campaign decision is promoted.

prompt_templates.title: Read Back One Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Read back the budget change for Campaign X. I changed it on June 10, and I have spend, revenue, conversions, and a control export.

prompt_templates.title: Judge Creative Rotation
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate the new creative set against the previous stable control. Use ROAS as the primary metric and CPA as the secondary metric.

prompt_templates.title: Normalize Cross-Platform ROAS
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Meta and Google paid campaigns using my exports. Normalize attribution window, currency, and conversion lag before recommending a decision.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Measurement Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a paid measurement handoff with sources, windows, control choice, caveats, decision, next patch, and next readback date.

output_examples.input: A budget increase has two weeks of candidate data and one unchanged sibling campaign as control.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a Promote, Keep-testing, Rollback, or Unproven verdict with the primary metric delta versus control, caveats, and next readback date.

output_examples.input: Meta and Google exports use different attribution windows and currencies.
output_examples.output: The skill flags the mismatch, requests normalization, and avoids a cross-platform ROAS comparison until the inputs are comparable.

output_examples.input: A campaign has strong platform-reported conversions but duplicate order IDs in analytics.
output_examples.output: The skill marks the readback untrustworthy, records the measurement blocker, and recommends fixing tracking before promotion.

best_practices: Set the readback window before reviewing results.
Use a control campaign, holdout, or comparable benchmark for every decision.
Label every figure as measured, user-provided, or estimated.
anti_patterns: Do not promote changes from dashboard screenshots alone.
Do not compare cross-platform ROAS before normalizing attribution and currency.
Do not treat modeled or dirty conversion data as a clean measured result.

faq.question: What decision does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces Promote, Keep-testing, Rollback, or Unproven with the readback window, control, metrics, and caveats.

faq.question: Does it calculate ROAS itself?
faq.answer: No. It delegates ROAS and CPA arithmetic to the ROI calculator workflow and owns the measurement decision.

faq.question: Can it work without ad platform APIs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use manually exported campaign, analytics, and ecommerce data supplied by the user.

faq.question: Why does it require a control?
faq.answer: A control separates likely campaign impact from market noise, seasonality, and unrelated account changes.

faq.question: What happens when tracking is broken?
faq.answer: The skill flags the readback as untrustworthy and recommends fixing the measurement signal before promotion.

faq.question: Which agents can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible skill hosts.
